styles.name: Bold
styles.description: Heavy Mathematical Bold letters and digits. One of the most widely supported styles. Works in most apps, browsers and phones.

styles.name: Italic
styles.description: Slanted Mathematical Italic letters. Digits are left unchanged because Unicode has no italic digits. Works in most apps, browsers and phones.

styles.name: Bold Italic
styles.description: Bold and slanted at once, using Mathematical Bold Italic letters. Works in most apps, browsers and phones.

styles.name: Cursive Script
styles.description: Flowing script capitals and lowercase from the Mathematical Script block, with a few Letterlike Symbols filling its gaps. Works in most modern apps; very old fonts may show boxes.

styles.name: Bold Cursive
styles.description: A heavier cursive alphabet that stays readable at small sizes. Works in most modern apps; very old fonts may show boxes.

styles.name: Old English
styles.description: Blackletter lettering in the style of medieval manuscripts and newspaper mastheads. Works in most modern apps; very old fonts may show boxes.

styles.name: Bold Gothic
styles.description: A bold blackletter alphabet with thicker strokes than classic Old English. Works in most modern apps; very old fonts may show boxes.

styles.name: Double-Struck
styles.description: Hollow, outlined letters used for number sets in mathematics, now popular for bios and names. Works in most modern apps; very old fonts may show boxes.

styles.name: Sans-Serif
styles.description: Clean sans-serif letters in the Mathematical block. Useful when you want a different weight of "plain". Works in most apps, browsers and phones.

styles.name: Sans Bold
styles.description: Bold sans-serif letters and digits; reads clearly on small screens. Works in most apps, browsers and phones.

styles.name: Sans Italic
styles.description: Slanted sans-serif letters with no digit substitutions. Works in most apps, browsers and phones.

styles.name: Sans Bold Italic
styles.description: Bold, slanted, sans-serif letters in one alphabet. Works in most apps, browsers and phones.

styles.name: Monospace
styles.description: Typewriter-style letters of equal width, in the Mathematical Monospace block. Works in most apps, browsers and phones.

styles.name: Wide (Fullwidth)
styles.description: Fullwidth Latin letters, the same forms used in East Asian typesetting and vaporwave text. Works in most apps, browsers and phones.

styles.name: Bubble (Circled)
styles.description: Letters inside circles. Digits 0 to 9 are circled as well. Works in most modern apps; very old fonts may show boxes.

styles.name: Filled Bubble
styles.description: Letters on filled black circles. Some systems draw these as emoji, so appearance varies. Support varies. Check your target app before relying on it.

styles.name: Squared
styles.description: Letters inside outlined squares. Support is patchy on older Android and Windows. Support varies. Check your target app before relying on it.

styles.name: Filled Squared
styles.description: Letters on filled black squares. May render as emoji-style tiles on some phones. Support varies. Check your target app before relying on it.

styles.name: Parenthesized
styles.description: Letters wrapped in parentheses as single characters. Support varies. Check your target app before relying on it.

styles.name: Small Caps
styles.description: Small capital letters. Looks the same for upper and lower case input. Works in most modern apps; very old fonts may show boxes.

styles.name: Superscript
styles.description: Raised mini letters and digits. A few letters share a glyph across cases. Works in most modern apps; very old fonts may show boxes.

styles.name: Subscript
styles.description: Lowered mini characters. Unicode only covers some letters; the rest stay normal. Support varies. Check your target app before relying on it.

styles.name: Underline Text
styles.description: Adds a single line under every letter using Unicode combining marks. Works on plain text, so it needs no special alphabet. Works in most apps, browsers and phones.

styles.name: Double Underline Text
styles.description: Adds two lines under every letter using Unicode combining marks. Works on plain text, so it needs no special alphabet. Works in most apps, browsers and phones.

styles.name: Overline Text
styles.description: Adds a line above every letter using Unicode combining marks. Works on plain text, so it needs no special alphabet. Works in most modern apps; very old fonts may show boxes.

styles.name: Strikethrough Text
styles.description: Adds a line through every letter using Unicode combining marks. Works on plain text, so it needs no special alphabet. Works in most modern apps; very old fonts may show boxes.

styles.name: Slash Text
styles.description: Adds a diagonal slash across every letter using Unicode combining marks. Works on plain text, so it needs no special alphabet. Works in most modern apps; very old fonts may show boxes.

styles.name: Wavy Text
styles.description: Adds a tilde mark above every letter using Unicode combining marks. Works on plain text, so it needs no special alphabet. Works in most modern apps; very old fonts may show boxes.

styles.name: Dotted Text
styles.description: Adds a dot below every letter using Unicode combining marks. Works on plain text, so it needs no special alphabet. Works in most modern apps; very old fonts may show boxes.

styles.name: Short Strikethrough Text
styles.description: Adds a short dash through the middle of every letter using Unicode combining marks. Works on plain text, so it needs no special alphabet. Works in most modern apps; very old fonts may show boxes.

styles.name: Short Slash Text
styles.description: Adds a short diagonal tick across every letter using Unicode combining marks. Works on plain text, so it needs no special alphabet. Works in most modern apps; very old fonts may show boxes.

styles.name: Tilde Underline Text
styles.description: Adds a small wave below every letter using Unicode combining marks. Works on plain text, so it needs no special alphabet. Works in most modern apps; very old fonts may show boxes.

styles.name: Tilde Strikethrough Text
styles.description: Adds a wavy line through every letter using Unicode combining marks. Works on plain text, so it needs no special alphabet. Works in most modern apps; very old fonts may show boxes.

styles.name: Bar Underline Text
styles.description: Adds a short bar below every letter using Unicode combining marks. Works on plain text, so it needs no special alphabet. Works in most modern apps; very old fonts may show boxes.

styles.name: Dot Above Text
